waivers.title: Named owners, approvers and reviewers are not assigned
waivers.risk: No accountable person exists to approve ADRs, waivers, SLOs or GO.
waivers.rationale: Cannot be resolved by engineering; organization must assign people.
waivers.compensating_controls: Every approval field left blank; gate refuses GO.

waivers.title: Adjacent layers exercised only via in-package reference implementations
waivers.risk: Real GAP-01/05/12/13 and PLN-07 implementations were not supplied with the candidate.
waivers.rationale: Contracts are versioned and schema-tested; reference adapters are executable specifications.
waivers.compensating_controls: negotiate() rejects unknown contracts; schemas validate every emitted message.

waivers.title: pk_core not supplied; conformance adapter suite skipped
waivers.risk: pk_core is external to the candidate archive.
waivers.rationale: Core runtime has no pk_core dependency.
waivers.compensating_controls: test_component.py retained unchanged; must be run where pk_core exists.

waivers.title: Dependency lock lacks wheel hashes
waivers.risk: Build sandbox had no package-index access.
waivers.rationale: Exact versions pinned; regeneration command documented in requirements.lock.
waivers.compensating_controls: Release gate lists this waiver as blocking.

waivers.title: No TPM/HSM/KMS key custody; not FIPS-validated
waivers.risk: Reference FileKeyProvider keeps keys (0600) beside state.
waivers.rationale: KeyProvider seam; AES-256-GCM + HMAC; key-file permission check; zeroization best effort.
waivers.compensating_controls: Production must supply a hardware-backed KeyProvider.

waivers.title: Release signing uses a locally generated key without HSM custody or CI builder identity
waivers.risk: No release infrastructure available to this work order.
waivers.rationale: Signature, SBOM and provenance mechanics are implemented and tamper-tested.
waivers.compensating_controls: Verification tool fails on any mismatch or wrong key.

waivers.title: No release CI; evidence is from local runs
waivers.rationale: evidence/test_results.json records the exact run; suites are deterministic and seeded.

waivers.title: Single-platform qualification (Linux x86_64, CPython 3.11)
waivers.rationale: POSIX durability assumptions documented; Windows lock path present but unqualified.
waivers.compensating_controls: Compatibility matrix marks other platforms untested.

waivers.title: No independent security review, penetration test, or vulnerability scan
waivers.risk: Requires independent team and network access to advisory databases.
waivers.rationale: Adversarial test suite; threat model; fail-closed design.

waivers.title: Performance measured on a container, not representative edge hardware; power not measured
waivers.rationale: Benchmark harness and capacity calculator re-runnable on target hardware.

waivers.title: Fencing is single-host (OS lock + persisted generation)
waivers.risk: Multi-host single authority needs a control-plane-issued generation/consensus lease.
waivers.rationale: Downstream FencingValidator rejects stale generations; epochs bound leases.
waivers.compensating_controls: Deploy one controller per site state directory only.

waivers.title: Trusted-time anti-rollback is software-only (no TPM NV counter)
waivers.risk: Whole-disk rollback while partitioned is undetectable locally (THREAT_MODEL R1).
waivers.rationale: HWM + journal MAC; detection at reconnect via authority epoch and audit head.

waivers.title: Per-site decision quota configured but not enforced
waivers.risk: quotas.decisions_per_minute is validated but not enforced.
waivers.rationale: Admission concurrency/queue bounds and max_decisions_per_partition enforce hard limits.
